overview: Vibrant Gujarat Regional Conferences (VGRC) are state-level events organized by the Government of Gujarat to drive regional industrial growth, attract sector-specific investments, and strengthen global engagement. These conferences replicate the model of the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit at the regional level and are aligned with the vision of Viksit Bharat @2047. The events feature industrial exhibitions, B2B/B2G meetings, MoU signings, regional awards for MSMEs and artisans, and participation from global diaspora and international partners.
objectives: Drive regional industrial growth across Gujarat
Attract sector-specific investments to regional areas
Strengthen global engagement and international partnerships
Showcase successful projects from previous Vibrant Gujarat Editions
Facilitate MoU signing and exchange between businesses and government
Recognize and award MSMEs and artisans through Regional Awards
Promote Udyami Mela and vendor development programs
Enable industrial and tourism excursions for participants

The conferences also facilitate networking with global diaspora and international partners.
